errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the spike near step 2800 reached a value of 12-15. The plot shows this spike, which is closer to step 2900, only reaches a value of approximately 10.5.
The description omits a prominent cluster of spikes that occurs around training step 6000, where the gradient norm reaches a value of approximately 12.
The description does not mention the legend located in the top right corner of the plot, which labels the line as "Gradient Norm of Reward Model".
